messages:
sara (Docs): Heads-up — product is scheduling a v1 API sunset for next month. Need a concise docs checklist: migration guide updates, tiny SDK snippets, model-swap examples, redirect rules, and short 'safeguard' snippets teams can drop in to avoid outages. Who takes what?

kevin (SDK): Ill take SDK snippets. Working on a lightweight compatibility wrapper + a 5-line Python and TS example for v1->v2. Will open draft PR today and include unit tests. cc @matt (Eng)

matt (Eng): For model swaps, include an explicit runtime fallback example to a pinned compatible variant and show rate-limit/backoff headers handling. Suggest adding a Dedicated checklist too (pin capacity, model overrides). Example snippet to show intent:
```
# py fallback sketch
def generate(req):
    try:
        return v2.client.generate(req)
    except IncompatibleModelError:
        return v1.client.generate(req)
```

yara (DevRel): Can we also surface a "safe-start" flag snippet that toggles auto-fallback if quality/regression checks fail? I'll add it to the quickstart app and link it from the guide.

ellen (Product): Important for docs: short "what changed / why" paragraph, explicit migration steps, and a clear note about embedding ID behavior changes. Marketing will announce one week before sunset — docs must be live before that.

sam (Support): Please include a one-click rollback snippet, and a support-friendly troubleshooting mini-FAQ (common error codes and quick resolutions). Dedicated customers need a separate rollback runbook (contacts, capacity steps).

kevin (SDK): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/2468  added compat wrapper, small tests, and migration checklist. Needs docs + eng review.

sara (Docs): I'll review. Keep inline snippets <=7 lines so they're copy/paste friendly; long examples go in sample-app with a "Full example" link. I'll also prepare an umbrella PR to wire redirects and add a troubleshooting section.

matt (Eng): Pushed a note about streaming framing changes in v2 — important to call out in streaming guide and in the migration checklist (consumer framing, reassembly).

docs-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/sha/f1a2b3c  preview includes migration page and snippets — please smoke-test.

yara (DevRel): :thumbsup: Ill add the sample-app PR tomorrow and link it from the migration guide. Tagging @kevin for final API shape alignment.

sara (Docs): One small ask: include a short regression-detection snippet that checks cosine-similarity for embeddings to detect sudden shifts post-swap. Keep it optional. Ping here when PRs are ready for final merge. :sparkles:
